name: rt-test-workspace
description: Queryable test state and named-defect evidence for Vitest projects.

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-workspace-scripts.mjs && tsc --noEmit && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.check:planning: node scripts/check-sprint-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-requirement-markers.mjs && node scripts/adr-index.mjs > /dev/null
scripts.rules:check: node scripts/expand-rules.mjs --doc checklist --list --quiet && node scripts/expand-rules.mjs --doc project-context --list --quiet && node scripts/check-rule-hygiene.mjs
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run check:planning && bun run rules:check && bun run check:skills && bun run test:run && bun run test:defects && bun run build
